items.title: Zcash jumps 23% as bitcoin and major tokens rise despite Fed’s first hike since 2023
items.summary: Bitcoin traded above $76,000 as the Fed projected limited further tightening, while Paradigm’s Matt Huang discussed Zcash’s role as a privacy complement to bitcoin.

items.title: Bitcoin absorbs Fed rate hike as officials see more tightening
items.summary: Bitcoin showed little immediate reaction to the Fed’s first rate increase since 2023, but 16 of 18 officials expect at least one more hike before the end of the year.

items.title: ‘Not the end’: Sen. Gillibrand says Democrats still committed to passing Clarity Act
items.summary: Industry analysts say it is highly unlikely for the bill to pass this Congress, and instead pointed to the SEC and CFTC's rulemaking efforts.

items.title: Bitcoin Round-Trips the First Fed Rate Increase Since 2023 as Zcash Runs to $1,383
items.summary: The Federal Open Market Committee voted 12-0 to lift its target range a quarter point to 3.75%-4%, and the median projection now puts the rate at 4.1% at the end of 2026 against 3.8% in June.
